_note: Wires each Next.js (App Router) page to its wireframe artboard(s) and the design system. Source of truth for what to build and what it should look like. Wireframes are lo-fi structure only — fidelity, color, spacing come from design.md, never from the wireframe's placeholder hex values.

meta.scope: No membership tiers, no payment, no social login. Browse is public; download requires username/email + password login; any logged-in user downloads any book.

conventions.loadingFile: loading.tsx renders the *Loading wireframe as a skeleton
conventions.emptyState: Rendered inside the page component when the data set is empty — maps to the *Empty wireframe
conventions.errorFile: error.tsx / inline field errors — never a bare error string
conventions.wireframePlaceholders: Boxes/bars in .dc.html are placeholders. Replace with real components from src/components. Do NOT copy the wireframe's inline CSS or hex colors.

pages.data: Curated rails (Sách mới cập nhật), hero, mega-menu source (79 categories). No filter sidebar on home.
pages.notes: Hero band + curated horizontal rails, NOT a filtered grid. Rails paint with skeletons while async.

pages.data: Full catalog, filterable. Reuses the Category list-grid shell (filter sidebar + grid + pagination).
pages.notes: Same shell as Category; the difference is data scope (all books vs one taxonomy branch).

dynamicParams: slug (catch-all, up to 3 taxonomy levels: e.g. can-lam-sang/chan-doan-hinh-anh/x-quang)
pages.data: Books within the taxonomy branch resolved from the catch-all slug. Breadcrumb reflects the path.
pages.notes: Catch-all route handles depth-4 tree. <768px filters collapse to a 'Bộ lọc' drawer.

pages.data: Native catalog search on ?q=. No Google CSE.
pages.notes: Empty state (SearchEmpty) shows a CTA back to browse. Search input reflects the current query.

pages.data: Single book: cover, meta (editor/language/publisher/SKU), description, related grid, recently-updated rail.

primaryAction.flow: logged-in => file downloads (CTA shows progress); logged-out => open AuthModal, resume download after login. No tier gate, no upsell.

pages.notes: BookLoading.dc.html is the skeleton for loading.tsx — a leaked error rail becomes a gracefully-hidden skeleton. <768px: CTA sticks to bottom.

pages.data: Account landing. Hero panel = My library (re-download) summary. Tabs: my library · requests · details · logout.
pages.notes: INFERRED from reference — member area was not captured live. Confirm nav items and landing content against the real member area (05-ux/BRIEF §3.4) before final build. ≥1024px 2-pane; md tabs.

pages.data: Table of downloaded books with a re-download control (Bet 2). Paginated.
pages.notes: DataTable columns/re-download control are INFERRED — confirm against live member area before build. Empty state (DownloadsEmpty) CTAs to browse.

pages.data: Editable profile fields. No payment/billing fields.
pages.notes: No dedicated wireframe — compose the account-dashboard shell + FormField set. No checkout fields.
No dedicated wireframe — reuse FormField. Inline validation, success state.
Reuse list-grid; BookCard 'article' variant. No dedicated wireframe.

wireframes.reuse: Prose body, max-w-prose, optional related rail

pages.data: Single article: title + prose body + optional related-posts rail.
pages.notes: article pattern — single column, wide readable measure (max-w-prose).
Body-only article. Also covers /huong-dan-tai-sach, /dieu-khoan, /bao-mat as static prose pages.

modals.notes: Username/email + password + submit + login/register toggle ONLY. NO Google/social button. The single gate: login => can download any book. Traps focus, Esc closes, resumes pending download after success. Errors render inline (AuthError), never a bare string.
modals.implementation: Render via a route-intercepting parallel route (app/@modal) or a global client modal store; the download CTA opens it when logged out.

deferred.reason: Orphan browse axis — reachable only from a book's author link/deep link; reuse list-grid
